# HyprlandBindMerge

> **File:** `services/HyprlandBindMerge.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

scripts/merge_hypr_binds.py: every hl.bind in user/*.lua that can move becomes one of axiom's binds (an action where one does the same, else the `lua` action), saved first, then its call is deleted from the file (a dated backup beside it). A call that couldn't be deleted has its binds taken back out of axiom's, so no key is ever bound twice. A key axiom binds too stays one bind, the user's replacing axiom's (BindKeys.mergeBinds). Runs by itself on the adopted file when a takeover adopts the previous hyprland.lua, so managed mode starts with no conflicts; the Keybinds page's Merge runs it on all of user/.

### Properties

- `enabled` (bool): Merging only happens in managed mode
- `hyprlandPath` (string): ~/.config/hypr/ and its user/ folder
- `userDir` (string)
- `merging` (readonly bool)
- `lastMerge` (var): The last merge: { moved, removed, kept: [{ file, line, key, reason, detail }], failed: [{ file, line, reason, detail }], remapped: [{ from, to, action }], tracked: [file], errors: [text], saveFailed …
- `mergeable` (int): How many binds a Merge of all of user/ would move (previewMerge()); -1 until looked

### Signals

- `bindsMerged(var binds)`: The binds a merge moved in for good (KeybindManager adds them to a draft with unsaved edits)

### Functions

- `mergeUserBinds(only)`: `only`: one file name in user/ (the adopted one), else all of them
- `previewMerge()`: Counts what a Merge would move, changing nothing (`mergeable`)
